errors.evidence: The figure shows the lowest total stacked bar in 2019, at roughly 330 million лв., not 2020 at about 610 million лв.
The 2013 bar appears closer to about 1550 million лв. than 1470 million лв.; this is a noticeable but not central numerical inaccuracy.
